briefing: - 未见在野利用和勒索软件标记，暂无公开PoC或Nuclei模板。
- 批量公告趋势明显：多条CVSS 10.0严重漏洞集中披露。
- 命令注入RCE与认证绕过批量出现，应优先全网排查。
- 最需立即处置：CVE-2026-101001，命令注入RCE，CVSS 10.0。
- 另需处置：CVE-2026-101077，认证绕过/缺失认证，10.0。

items.title: NestJS 消息模式致服务崩溃
items.title_zh: NestJS 消息模式致服务崩溃
items.summary_zh: 可访问TCP端口或发布RabbitMQ消息者，发送畸形消息模式可致服务崩溃。
items.action_zh: 升级NestJS并校验消息模式，限制TCP端口与RabbitMQ队列访问。
items.repro_note: 入口为TCP微服务或RabbitMQ队列，发送非字符串pattern触发异常。
items.impact_scope: Node.js微服务，内网队列暴露面
items.description: Nest is a framework for building scalable Node.js server-side applications. An attacker who can reach the TCP port or publish to the consumed RabbitMQ queue or exchange can crash the service on demand; other transports are not affected because their patterns arrive as strings.

items.title: Nginx代理管理 登录接口爆破
items.title_zh: Nginx代理管理 登录接口爆破
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可无限猜密码及TOTP，成功后接管Nginx Proxy Manager管理后台。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 限制管理面板访问，启用强口令/MFA，关注厂商更新。
items.repro_note: POST /api/tokens 猜密码，后爆破2FA接口
items.impact_scope: 反向代理管理面板，常暴露公网
items.description: Nginx Proxy Manager through 2.16.0 lacks rate-limiting on authentication endpoints, allowing unauthenticated attackers to make unlimited password guesses against any account. Attackers can brute-force login credentials via POST /api/tokens and subsequently guess TOTP codes via POST /api/tokens/2fa to gain full session access and administrative control.

items.title: NPM 非管理员注入Nginx指令
items.title_zh: NPM 非管理员注入Nginx指令
items.summary_zh: 具管理权限的非管理员可在advanced_config注入Nginx指令，读文件或劫持路由。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，advanced_config仅限管理员可写。
items.repro_note: 登录非管理员账号，在高级配置字段注入alias等Nginx指令。
items.impact_scope: 反向代理管理面板，影响托管站点
items.description: Nginx Proxy Manager through 2.16.0 fails to restrict the advanced_config field to administrators, allowing non-admin users with manage permissions to inject arbitrary nginx directives. Attackers can inject malicious nginx configuration such as alias directives to serve arbitrary files or control routing for their assigned hosts.

items.title: OA协同办公 栈溢出远程代码执行
items.title_zh: OA协同办公 栈溢出远程代码执行
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可通过构造请求触发栈溢出，可能导致OA系统崩溃或代码执行。
items.action_zh: 厂商未响应，暂无官方修复；建议下线或限制受影响OA访问。
items.repro_note: 受影响OA产品及入口未披露，需定位栈溢出服务与参数。
items.impact_scope: OA/协同办公系统，高暴露资产
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Netcore NR289-GE 1.4.5102. The affected element is the function password-check of the file /bin/boa of the component Authentication. Executing a manipulation of the argument Username can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: mall4j 未授权重置任意账户密码
items.title_zh: mall4j 未授权重置任意账户密码
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者调用PUT /user/updatePwd，提交目标用户名即可重置任意账户密码。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复；无法升级则下线或强制鉴权该接口。
items.repro_note: 未授权PUT /user/updatePwd传目标username改密码。
items.impact_scope: 商城前台与会员账户，可致接管
items.description: mall4j through 4.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT /user/updatePwd endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset any storefront account password. Attackers can supply a target username in the request body to overwrite passwords without verification, enabling account takeover and access to orders and personal data.

items.title: Netcore NBR200V2 命令注入
items.title_zh: Netcore NBR200V2 命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵QUERY_STRING参数注入系统命令，可能完全控制路由器。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取固件修复；无法修复则隔离设备。
items.repro_note: 远程向 CGI 的 QUERY_STRING 参数注入 shell 命令。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Netcore NBR200V2 1.3.241127.071246. This impacts the function eval of the file /www/cgi-bin/network_tools of the component Web Management Interface. Such manipulation of the argument QUERY_STRING leads to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Netcore NR289-GE 命令注入
items.title_zh: Netcore NR289-GE 命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵 /ap_ip.cgi 的 ip 参数注入系统命令，可能完全控制路由器。
items.action_zh: 厂商未响应，暂无官方修复；建议停用或限制CGI访问。
items.repro_note: 远程请求 /ap_ip.cgi，向 ip 参数注入 shell 命令。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Netcore NR289-GE 1.4.5102. This issue affects the function system of the file /ap_ip.cgi of the component CGI Handler. Such manipulation of the argument ip leads to os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Netcore NR289-GE NTP注入
items.title_zh: Netcore NR289-GE NTP注入

items.action_zh: 厂商未响应，暂无官方修复；建议停用或限制CGI访问。
items.repro_note: 远程请求 /set_ntp_server_ip.cgi，向 ntp_ip 注入命令。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网

The manipulation of the argument ntp_ip results in os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Netcore NR289-GE 认证绕过
items.title_zh: Netcore NR289-GE 认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用boa_temp处理缺失认证，绕过登录访问设备功能。
items.action_zh: 厂商未响应，暂无官方修复；建议停用或限制管理访问。
items.repro_note: 远程访问 boa_temp 处理路径，跳过认证调用受保护功能。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A flaw has been found in Netcore NR289-GE 1.4.5102. This impacts the function process_request of the component boa_temp Handler. This manipulation causes missing authentication. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Netcore NAP930 命令注入
items.title_zh: Netcore NAP930 命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵sid参数注入系统命令，可能完全控制NAP930设备。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取修复；无法修复则隔离设备或限制访问。
items.repro_note: 远程向受影响 CGI 的 sid 参数注入 shell 命令。
items.impact_scope: 边界网络设备，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Netcore NAP930 0.1.241010.141410. This affects the function eval of the file /www/cgi-bin/network_tools of the component Network Tools CGI. The manipulation of the argument sid results in os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Apache Roller 反序列化RCE
items.title_zh: Apache Roller 反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向XML-RPC发送恶意扩展类型，请求解析时反序列化可致RCE。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，禁用/过滤XML-RPC厂商扩展类型。
items.repro_note: 未授权向 XML-RPC 端点发送携带厂商扩展类型的请求。
items.impact_scope: Apache Roller 博客站，Web入口可RCE
items.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller 6.1.5 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause deserialization of attacker-controlled bytes, because the XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types that are deserialized during request parsing, before authentication. This can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: IdentityIQ API 未授权RCE
items.title_zh: IdentityIQ API 未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者向 IdentityIQ Web 服务 API 提交畸形内容即可远程执行代码，完全控制服务器。
items.action_zh: 厂商暂无补丁信息；限制 Web 服务 API 对外访问并拦截异常输入。
items.repro_note: 未认证请求 Web 服务 API，在传入内容中构造畸形参数触发代码执行。
items.impact_scope: 企业身份治理平台，内网核心系统
items.description: This vulnerability impacts all versions of IdentityIQ and allows an unauthenticated user remote code execution on the IdentityIQ server due to improper input validation of submitted web service API content.

items.title: Netcore NBR100V2 越权
items.title_zh: Netcore NBR100V2 越权
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可利用缺失授权访问受影响接口，可能读取或修改路由器配置。
items.action_zh: 联系厂商获取固件修复；无法修复则隔离管理接口。
items.repro_note: 入口未披露，需审计NBR100V2接口缺失授权点。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in Netcore NBR100V2 1.3.240614.030928. This affects the function uci.apply of the file /usr/share/rpcd/acl.d/unauthenticated.json of the component ACL Handler. This manipulation of the argument section causes missing authorization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: FAST FAC1900R 栈溢出RCE
items.title_zh: FAST FAC1900R 栈溢出RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向devdiscover服务发送特制消息触发栈溢出，可能导致设备被控。
items.action_zh: 厂商未响应，暂无官方修复；建议隔离并关闭devdiscover服务。
items.repro_note: 远程向 devdiscover 服务发送特制消息，触发 copy_msg_element 溢出。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in FAST FAC1900R 20190827_2.0.2. Affected by this issue is the function copy_msg_element of the component devdiscover Service. Such manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 网络设备 CGI 命令注入
items.title_zh: 网络设备 CGI 命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵mac参数注入系统命令，可能导致网络设备被完全控制。
items.action_zh: 产品未披露，建议排查使用mac参数的CGI并限制访问。
items.repro_note: 产品与入口未披露，需定位使用 mac 参数的 CGI 接口。
items.impact_scope: 边界网络设备，可能暴露公网
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Netcore NR289-GE 1.4.5102. The impacted element is the function system of the file /location_time.cgi of the component Location Time Handler. The manipulation of the argument mac leads to os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 网络设备 url参数命令注入
items.title_zh: 网络设备 url参数命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵url参数注入系统命令，可能导致设备被完全控制。
items.action_zh: 产品未披露，建议排查使用url参数的CGI并限制访问。
items.repro_note: 产品与入口未披露，需定位使用 url 参数的 CGI 接口。
items.impact_scope: 边界网络设备，可能暴露公网
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Netcore NBR200V2 1.3.241127.071246. Affected is the function system of the file /usr/bin/network_tools of the component Tools Ping Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument url results in os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Apache Roller 博客越权操作
items.title_zh: Apache Roller 博客越权操作
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户可通过legacy XML-RPC接口越权读取、修改或删除他人博客内容。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本，禁用Blogger/MetaWeblog XML-RPC接口。
items.repro_note: 认证后调用XML-RPC，指定他人weblog/entry ID。
items.impact_scope: Apache Roller 多租户博客内容
items.description: Missing Authorization in Apache Roller 6.1.5 allows an authenticated user to read, modify, or delete weblog content belonging to other weblogs through the legacy XML-RPC Blogger and MetaWeblog APIs, because the handlers authenticate the caller but do not verify the caller's permission on the weblog or entry actually affected. Only installations that enable the non-default global XML-RPC setting are affected; the per-weblog API flag defaults to enabled for UI-created weblogs.

items.title: FAST FAC1200R 栈溢出RCE
items.title_zh: FAST FAC1200R 栈溢出RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向devdiscover服务发送特制帧触发栈溢出，可能导致设备被控。

items.repro_note: 远程向 devdiscover 服务发送特制帧，触发 parse_advertisement_frame 溢出。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was found in FAST FAC1200R 5.0_20201119_1.0.2. Affected is the function parse_advertisement_frame of the component devdiscover Service. The manipulation results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: FAST FAC1200R 栈溢出漏洞
items.title_zh: FAST FAC1200R 栈溢出漏洞
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可能通过构造请求触发栈溢出，导致FAC1200R崩溃或代码执行。

items.repro_note: 入口及参数未披露，需结合设备定位栈溢出服务。
items.impact_scope: 边界路由器，常暴露公网
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in FAST FAC1200R 5.0_20201119_1.0.2. Affected by this vulnerability is the function MmtAtePrase of the component MmtAtePrase Parser. This manipulation causes stack-based buffer overflow. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: LXD Btrfs备份路径遍历提权
items.title_zh: LXD Btrfs备份路径遍历提权
items.summary_zh: 具实例创建权限用户导入特制Btrfs优化备份，可以root删改宿主任意文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复；限制实例创建权限并审计备份导入。
items.repro_note: 以实例创建权限导入备份，构造subvolumes[].path遍历宿主。
items.impact_scope: 容器/云主机宿主，可逃逸至root
items.description: Path traversal in the Btrfs storage driver (unpackVolume) in Canonical LXD on Linux allows an authenticated user with instance creation privileges to delete or replace arbitrary files and directories on the host filesystem as root via a crafted subvolumes[].path entry in backup/optimized_header.yaml during a btrfs optimized backup import.

items.title: LXD迁移接收链接解析写文件
items.title_zh: LXD迁移接收链接解析写文件
items.summary_zh: 具实例或存储卷权限客户端或恶意迁移源，可root写宿主任意文件。
items.repro_note: 认证客户端发起迁移/导入，构造链接绕过解析写宿主路径。
items.impact_scope: LXD容器宿主，租户可获root
items.description: Improper link resolution in the migration receive path in Canonical LXD versions 4.0 and later (fixed in 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8 and 6.10) on Linux allows an authenticated client that can create instances or custom storage volumes in a project, or a malicious migration source server, to write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary paths on the target host as root, leading to full host compromise.

items.title: Logsign SIEM 默认凭据登录漏洞
items.title_zh: Logsign SIEM 默认凭据登录漏洞
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可用产品默认用户名口令直接登录 Logsign SIEM，获得高权限并完全接管平台。
items.action_zh: 升级到 6.4.117 及以上；立即修改默认口令并限制管理端口暴露。
items.repro_note: 对 SIEM 登录入口（Web/管理端口）尝试厂商默认用户名口令组合。
items.impact_scope: SIEM 平台，多部署于内网管理区
items.description: Use of default credentials vulnerability in Innotim Software, Telecommunications and Consultancy Trade Ltd. Co. Logsign SIEM allows Try Common or Default Usernames and Passwords. This issue affects Logsign SIEM: from 6.4.101 before 6.4.117.

items.title: LXD btrfs驱动路径遍历删任意文件
items.title_zh: LXD btrfs驱动路径遍历删任意文件
items.summary_zh: 已认证且可在项目内创建实例的用户，借 btrfs 存储驱动路径遍历，以 root 删除宿主机任意文件。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.repro_note: 需已认证且有实例创建权限，构造 btrfs 存储路径穿越条目删宿主文件。
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机宿主机，横向逃逸跳板
items.description: Path traversal in the btrfs storage driver in Canonical LXD versions 4.0.2 and later (fixed in 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8 and 6.10) on Linux allows an authenticated client with permission to create instances in a project to delete arbitrary files on the host as root. The client does this with a crafted subvolume path containing ../ sequences, sent in either of two ways: in the optimized_header.yaml of an optimized btrfs backup, or in the btrfs migration header sent by a malicious migration source.

items.title: Rancher UI 未授权存储型XSS
items.title_zh: Rancher UI 未授权存储型XSS
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者可篡改公开 UI 设置注入恶意脚本，管理员浏览 Rancher UI 时触发并泄露会话。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至 2.15.2、2.14.6 等修复版本，收紧公开设置写入。
items.repro_note: 未授权调用公开 UI 设置更新接口写入脚本载荷，等待管理员访问页面触发。
items.impact_scope: 容器管理控制台，运维高价值目标
items.description: An unauthenticated update of public UI settings could be used by remote attackers to execute a stored cross-site scripting attack in the Rancher UI, in SUSE Rancher 2.15 before 2.15.2, 2.14 before 2.14.6, 2.13 before 2.13.10, 2.12 before 2.12.14 and 2.11 before 2.11.18.

items.title: 未知组件栈溢出局域网可触发
items.title_zh: 未知组件栈溢出局域网可触发
items.summary_zh: 同一局域网内攻击者向目标服务发送恶意数据触发栈溢出，可造成内存破坏乃至代码执行。
items.action_zh: 隔离受影响服务网段，限制非可信主机访问，关注厂商公告。
items.repro_note: 需本地网络可达，向目标服务端口发送超长或畸形数据触发栈溢出。
items.impact_scope: 局域网内暴露服务，可致内存破坏
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in FAST FAC1203R 20200116_2.0.4. The affected element is the function _tWlanTask of the component MmtAtePrase Parser. Performing a manipulation results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attacker must have access to the local network to execute the attack. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Untrusted Data 反序列化(RCE)
items.description: A Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in the JavaScript Task in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-06-28 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated user with standard permissions to run arbitrary code on the shared production servers using a specially crafted script bypassing param guards. This vulnerability was patched on 28 June 2026, and no customer action is needed.

items.title: Dayforce Payroll 未授权 SQL注入
items.description: Dayforce Payroll is vulnerable to Time Based-Blind SQL Injection in password recovery functionality. The unauthenticated attacker can prepare GET request with one of the parameters filled in with an arbitrary SQL query. The parameter is interpreted as part of SQL predicate resulting in Time-Based Blind SQL Injection. Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version R2026.2.0 but may also affect other versions.

items.title: 未授权 访问控制缺失
items.description: An improper access control vulnerability in an internal API service on WatchGuard Access Points allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the AP to obtain a valid API session.

items.title: WatchGuard AP 未授权 命令注入(RCE)
items.description: An OS command injection vulnerability in the WatchGuard AP internal API service allows an attacker with network access to the AP to execute arbitrary shell commands on the underlying operating system.

items.title: Dayforce Payroll 未授权 路径遍历/任意文件读取
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.description: Dayforce Payroll is vulnerable to Path Traversal in file download functionality. An unauthenticated attacker can sent GET request with file path parameter set to any path including an absolute local file path. Because vendor contact attempts were unsuccessful, the vulnerability has only been confirmed in version R2026.2.0 but may also affect other versions.

items.title: 压缩包符号链接链路径遍历致RCE
items.title_zh: 压缩包符号链接链路径遍历致RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者投递含链式符号链接的恶意压缩包，解压时可读写目录外文件，覆盖启动脚本实现代码执行。
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；解压前校验归档条目，禁止符号链接逃逸覆盖启动脚本。
items.repro_note: 构造含链式 symlink 的归档，经解压流程写入输出目录之外的启动脚本。
items.impact_scope: 使用归档解压的服务器与构建流程
items.description: An attacker can supply a crafted archive containing chained symlink entries so that a later entry resolves outside the output directory. This allows files outside output to be read or written, and overwriting startup scripts or configuration can lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Bluehood 仪表盘未授权访问与篡改
items.title_zh: Bluehood 仪表盘未授权访问与篡改
items.summary_zh: 网络攻击者无需会话 Cookie 即可访问 Bluehood 仪表盘端口，读取蓝牙跟踪数据并篡改多项配置状态。
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；将仪表盘端口限制在内网并前置认证代理。
items.repro_note: 未携带会话 Cookie 直接请求仪表盘端口接口，读取数据或修改配置项。
items.impact_scope: 内网蓝牙监控面板，暴露即被接管
items.description: Bluehood monitors local bluetooth activity. A network attacker reachable on the dashboard port could read Bluetooth tracking data and modify application state — including the heartbeat URL, prune retention, device groups, and per-device notes — without a session cookie.

items.title: PyJWT 公钥伪造HMAC令牌绕过签名
items.title_zh: PyJWT 公钥伪造HMAC令牌绕过签名
items.summary_zh: 知晓服务端公钥的攻击者可将其作为 HMAC 密钥伪造 JWT，绕过签名校验冒充任意用户。
items.action_zh: 升级 PyJWT 修复版本；禁用 HMAC 算法并固定签名算法白名单。
items.repro_note: 服务端接受 HS256 时，以公钥为密钥签发伪造 JWT 提交鉴权接口。
items.impact_scope: 使用 PyJWT 鉴权的 Web 服务
items.description: PyJWT is a Python implementation of JSON Web Token standards. Consequently, an attacker who knows the public key can forge authenticated HMAC tokens.

items.title: BaoTa 注入
items.description: A vulnerability was found in aaPanel BaoTa up to 11.8.0. Impacted is the function merge_split_file of the file /www/server/panel/class/files.py of the component File Merge Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument split_file_path results in command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Web Administration Service. The 内存破坏
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DI-8400 16.07. This vulnerability affects the function menu_nat_more_asp of the file menu_nat_more.asp of the component Web Administration Service. The manipulation of the argument opt results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: 注入
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This vulnerability affects the function pop_usb_device of the file usr/lib/lua/luci/controller/api/zrUsb.lua of the component USB Device Management API. This manipulation of the argument path causes command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Ziroom ZHOME A0101 注入
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /api/ZRnetwork/firstLogin. Performing a manipulation of the argument firstLogin results in command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Executing 注入
items.description: A flaw has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file /api/ZRnetwork/firstSetup_wifi. Executing a manipulation of the argument login_pwd can lead to command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: 注入
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file /api/ZRQos/set_online_client. The manipulation of the argument ip leads to command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Ziroom ZHOME A0101 注入
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /api/ZRQos/set_online_client. The manipulation of the argument mac results in command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Ziroom ZHOME A0101 注入
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0. Impacted is an unknown function of the file /api/ZRnetwork/set_passwd. This manipulation of the argument password1 causes command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: Roller OAuth授权端点越权绑定账户
items.title_zh: Roller OAuth授权端点越权绑定账户
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者获知有效 request token 后，可提交未签名授权请求将其绑定任意账户，含管理员。
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 关注官方修复；临时停用 OAuth 1.0a 端点或站点级 consumer。
items.repro_note: 持有效 request token，向 OAuth 授权端点提交未签名请求绑定管理员账户。
items.impact_scope: 开源博客/门户服务器，多暴露公网
items.description: Incorrect Authorization in the OAuth 1.0a authorization endpoint of Apache Roller 6.1.5 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker who learns an outstanding request token for a configured site-wide consumer to bind that token to an arbitrary user account, including an administrator, by submitting an unsigned authorization request. Only installations that configure an OAuth 1.0a site-wide consumer are affected, and exploitation requires knowledge of one of its outstanding request tokens.

items.title: GCP 应用集成任务越权调用内部RPC
items.title_zh: GCP 应用集成任务越权调用内部RPC
items.summary_zh: 已认证 GCP 用户可借任务配置越权，以特权身份在谷歌生产网内执行任意内部 RPC。
items.action_zh: 关注 Google 修复；最小化任务配置权限，审计内部 RPC 调用。
items.repro_note: 认证 GCP 用户创建含内部专用任务类型的集成，触发越权内部 RPC 调用。
items.impact_scope: Google Cloud 租户，内部RPC越权
items.description: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in the task configuration in Google Cloud Application Integration versions prior to 2026-06-17 on Google Cloud Platform allows an authenticated Google Cloud user to execute arbitrary internal RPCs from inside Google's production network under a privileged identity using an internal-only task type. This vulnerability was patched on 17 June 2026, and no customer action is needed.
